intro: Every piece is made to measure, so every quote is individual. These guide prices give you a sense of the investment before we talk.

cabinets.item: Base cabinet, 600mm, hand-painted, with solid wood dovetailed drawer or door

worktops.item: Stone (granite or quartz), templated by specialist, fitted alongside the kitchen

typical: Most complete handmade kitchens fall between £15,000 and £35,000, depending on size, timber and finish.
footnote: Prices include design, making and fitting, and exclude appliances, plumbing, electrics and tiling. Every quote is fixed and itemised after a site visit.
